description: A vibrant Vietnamese-style noodle salad is presented in a decorative bowl, featuring cooked shrimp, halved hard-boiled eggs, thin rice vermicelli noodles, fresh lettuce, bean sprouts, cilantro, shredded banana blossom, and crunchy fried shallots, accompanied by two dipping sauces (one clear with chili and onion, one orange-yellow) and lime wedges on a bamboo tray.

A bowl of Vietnamese pho with flat rice noodles, thinly sliced beef, white onion, chopped green onions, and red chili slices in a clear broth, served with fresh basil, a lime wedge, star anise, and bay leaves on a wooden surface.

A Vietnamese-style noodle bowl featuring grilled glazed meat topped with sesame seeds, served over white vermicelli noodles, fresh lettuce, sliced cucumbers, shredded carrots, shredded white vegetables, and roasted peanuts, accompanied by a side of dipping sauce with pickled carrots and white vegetables, and a wooden spoon holding minced garlic and sliced red chili peppers.

A vibrant Vietnamese Cơm Tấm style dish featuring a mound of white rice topped with green onions and fried pork rind, a glossy grilled pork chop, a sunny-side-up fried egg, a wedge of steamed egg meatloaf, and shredded pork skin, accompanied by pickled julienned carrots and daikon, fresh sliced cucumbers, sliced tomatoes (one shaped into a rose), a whole red chili, and a side of leafy green lettuce with a dipping sauce.
